textPaginationStopComplete.description: Pagination stop reason: the article ended naturally.

textPaginationStopPageLimit.description: Pagination stop reason: the maximum page count was reached.

textPaginationStopAlreadyVisited.description: Pagination stop reason: the next page URL was already visited.

textPaginationStopHttpError.description: Pagination stop reason: the next page returned an HTTP error status.

textPaginationStopDuplicatePage.description: Pagination stop reason: the next page duplicated the previous page.

textPaginationStopFetchFailed.description: Pagination stop reason: fetching the next page failed.

textPaginationStopNoArticle.description: Pagination stop reason: no article could be extracted for the section.

textGenerateFailed.description: Shown when book generation throws an unexpected error.
